newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Enseval soars on share sale news.
newsitem.headline: Enseval soars on share sale news.

text.p: Shares of Indonesia's PT Enseval Putra Megatrading soared in late trading on Friday following news that the trading firm had reduced its stake in photo equipment distributor Inter Delta, brokers said.
Enseval rose 100 rupiah, or 8.33 percent, to 1,300 rupiah in active trading.
"The report of the share sale and the company's negotiation with a foreign firm to set up a joint venture boosted sentiment on the share," one broker with a foreign brokerage firm said.

Enseval managing director Krishnan Sjarif told Reuters on Thursday that the company had reduced its stake in Inter Delta to 15.04 percent from the previous 30.04 percent and was in talks with a foreign firm to set up a joint venture.
